children.value: > Fact From Story The Epoch Times also spent millions to boost its own affiliates and connected organizations in 2021, including $10.4 million to the dance troupe Shen Yun, and $8.3 million to New Tang Dynasty, which produces videos.
> > Fact From Story Li holds that the Falun Gong messages, shared in articles, videos and dance performances, will result in the salvation of humankind as the end of the world nears.
> > Fact From Story The three groups, united under the Falun Gong religious movement, made up a nearly quarter-billion dollar industry in 2021, according to tax documents.
> > Commonsense Knowledge If two organizations are united under a religious movement, then they are connected to that religious movement.
